name: IQM Quantum Computers
description: IQM Quantum Computers is a European leader in building superconducting quantum computers. Based in Finland, IQM provides on-premises quantum computers and partners with EuroHPC to integrate quantum accelerators into European supercomputing centers. IQM focuses on application-specific co-design for industrial quantum advantage.

products.name: IQM Spark
products.description: Compact 5-qubit superconducting quantum computer designed for research labs and educational institutions

products.name: IQM Radiance
products.description: High-performance superconducting quantum processor for national computing centers and industrial co-design

highlights: Europe's largest quantum computing company with 250+ employees and EUR 337M+ cash post-listing
Listed on Nasdaq (IQMX) and Nasdaq Helsinki in July 2026, the first European quantum computing company to go public
Supplies quantum accelerators to EuroHPC supercomputing centers across Europe; 26 systems sold, 17 delivered globally as of August 2026

news.title: IQM Appoints Craig Ciesla, Former Illumina VP, as CTO; Inés de Vega Becomes Chief Scientist
news.excerpt: IQM announces leadership changes with Craig Ciesla joining as Chief Technology Officer and Inés de Vega becoming Chief Scientist.

news.title: Finland's IQM to become one of Europe's first listed quantum companies at $1.8 billion valuation
news.excerpt: IQM announces plans for an initial public offering via SPAC merger with Real Asset Acquisition Corp, targeting a New York primary listing with $1.8 billion valuation and possible dual listing on Helsinki stock exchange.

news.title: IQM to Deploy Japan's First Enterprise-Purchased Quantum Computer
news.excerpt: IQM Quantum Computers reaches agreement with TOYO Corporation for deployment of IQM Radiance 20-qubit system, marking Japan's first enterprise-purchased quantum computer with scheduled delivery by end of 2026.

news.title: IQM begins trading on Nasdaq as Europe's first publicly listed quantum computing company
news.excerpt: IQM completed its business combination with Real Asset Acquisition Corp. and began trading as IQMX on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on July 2, 2026, and on Nasdaq Helsinki on July 3. The company raised EUR 127 million in PIPE financing, bringing total cash reserves to approximately EUR 337 million, providing runway to Q2 2028.

news.title: LUMI AI Factory selects IQM to deploy Halocene H4 quantum computer for hybrid HPC-AI acceleration
news.excerpt: The LUMI AI Factory (operated by CSC, Finland) selected IQM to deliver the Halocene H4 superconducting quantum computer — described as the first system combining quantum error correction with NISQ qubits — for deployment in 2027. The contract is jointly funded by the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking and five national governments including Finland, Czechia, Norway, and Poland.

news.title: IQM reports first earnings as a public company: EUR 8.9M H1 revenue, EUR 102M order backlog
news.excerpt: IQM's first earnings report as a listed company showed H1 2026 revenues of EUR 8.87 million (+47% YoY), an order backlog of EUR 102.1 million as of August 3, and FY 2026 guidance of EUR 42–47 million revenue. IQM has sold 26 full-stack quantum computers and delivered 17 globally, with new customers including Galaxy Systemy Informatyczne (Poland, first private enterprise globally to purchase an IQM system) and TOYO Corporation (Japan).
